title: Let the King Take It
setup: Black's king is on a2 with a pawn on b2 about to promote, its bishop on a6 and rook on h8 watching from afar.
hint: The pawn is not the danger — the king behind it is. Look for the sacrifice that turns the shelter into a road.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxb2+}} gives a rook to pull the king onto the rank your other rook owns. {{Kxb2}} is forced, {{Rd2+}} drives it to c3, and {{Qc1#}} ends it. A king that captures is a king that has been moved where you wanted it.
